lines: Iri can alter another person’s thoughts, but she cannot make her own empty home feed her.

title: The cost of staying alive
lines: Trying to meet their own needs means changing lives they barely understand.
This speculative novel follows frightened young beings placed in the role of gods.
They can change another life long before they know what that change will cost.
